title: A kb-content gate that names a private key label in its question is classed design, not secrets
goal: bl_authority.class_reasons classes a gate of a kb-content-only item whose question names a key label such as PRIVATE KEY (which source states a label, how a fact words it) as design, while a gate on a real secret value or an item touching a secret-bearing file stays secrets. Found by the SP-5xnbspyp close: ST-qwrhatjh's g1 (which source states the DSA PRIVATE KEY label) was made blocking, class secrets, by the words PRIVATE KEY alone, and its landing waited for an operator answer.
notes: A ruling on what secrets class covers is the operator's: ask a gate before the work (the safe default keeps secrets).
